name: Kedma
title: Ishmael's son
summary: Kedma was the youngest of Ishmael's twelve sons and thus a grandson of Abraham. He became the ancestor of an Arab tribe, and his name is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles. As one of Ishmael's twelve sons, he fulfilled God's promise that Ishmael would become the father of twelve princes.

keyEvents.title: God's Promise of Ishmael's Twelve Sons
keyEvents.description: God promised Abraham that Ishmael would be fruitful and become the father of twelve princes, which was fulfilled through Kedmah and his eleven brothers.

keyEvents.title: Kedmah Mentioned in Ishmael's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Kedmah is listed as the twelfth and last of Ishmael's sons in the genealogy found in Genesis.

keyEvents.title: Ishmael's Sons as Twelve Princes
keyEvents.description: Ishmael's twelve sons, including Kedmah, are described as twelve princes over their respective tribes and settlements.

keyEvents.title: Kedmah in the Genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Kedmah is also mentioned in the great genealogy in 1 Chronicles as one of Ishmael's sons.

keyEvents.title: The Death and Descendants of Ishmael
keyEvents.description: After Ishmael died at the age of 137, his descendants, including Kedmah's tribe, settled in the region east of Egypt toward Assyria.
